transcript.text: If you have fair skin, light eyes, and low to medium contrast coloring, you may fall into the light summer color season.
So listen closely for your very best colors to wear.
Your best neutrals are soft white, dove gray, cool beige, dusty taupe, light mushroom, misty navy, and pale stone.
These colors support the skin instead of sitting on top of it.
Your best accents are powder blue, periwinkle, cool pink, soft raspberry, lavender, seafoam, icy rose, and muted aqua.
These shades bring life into the face without overpowering the eyes.
Avoid jet blacks, burnt orange, mustard, deep camel, and neon brights as they create too much visual weight and can make the skin look flat and exhausted.
Pause here for the cheat sheet. Comment which celebrity coloration we should cover next.
And if you want us to analyze your face, click the link in bio at Qoves.com.

Present ideal neutral colors for the 'Light Summer' palette.
Present ideal accent colors that complement the skin tone.
Showcase colors to avoid and explain why they are unflattering.
